Maîtriser la Pascaline. Pascal en a raté: Master the Pascaline. Pascal botched some fifty before the right one; how many quizzes for you?
Pascal a construit une cinquantaine de p: Pascal built some fifty prototypes before presenting his machine in 1645. About twenty Pascalines were made; nine still exist.
Maîtriser le binaire. Leibniz y voyait l: Master binary. Leibniz saw Creation in it; you'll mostly see zeros.
Le 1er avril 1703, Leibniz reçoit une le: On April 1, 1703, Leibniz receives a letter written in Beijing by the Jesuit Joachim Bouvet: the hexagrams of the Yi Jing read like binary numbers. He sends his article to the Academy within the week.
Maîtriser les cartes perforées de Jacqua: Master Jacquard's punched cards. A whole trade replaced by cardboard: think about it before you believe you're indispensable.
Le brevet de Jacquard, du 23 décembre 18: Jacquard's patent, of December 23, 1801, describes a machine "intended to replace the draw boy", the worker who lifted the threads of the pattern by hand.
Maîtriser la machine de Babbage. Personn: Master Babbage's engine. No one built it; you, at least, understood it.
Babbage raconte que deux membres du Parl: Babbage tells how two members of Parliament asked him whether, if you put wrong figures into his machine, right answers would come out. He admits he cannot understand what confusion of ideas could lead to such a question.
Maîtriser la note G. Le premier programm: Master note G. The first program already had a bug; you're in good company.
Dans le programme de la note G d'Ada Lov: In the program of Ada Lovelace's note G, the division in operation 4 is written upside down. No one saw it in her lifetime: the engine was never built to run it.
Maîtriser les circuits de Shannon. Le si: Master Shannon's circuits. His founded digital electronics; yours fits in a quiz.
Herman Goldstine disait que le mémoire d: Herman Goldstine said that Shannon's thesis had taken digital circuit design "from an art to a science".
Maîtriser le programme enregistré. Les i: Master the stored program. Instructions and data in the same drawer: nobody has ever done better.
L'EDSAC de Cambridge exécute ses premier: Cambridge's EDSAC runs its first programs on May 6, 1949, less than a year after the Manchester Baby.
Maîtriser Grace Hopper et le compilateur: Master Grace Hopper and the compiler. Your first bug won't be your last.
Le cahier du Mark II, avec son papillon: The Mark II logbook, with its moth taped in on September 9, 1947, is kept at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History. The word "bug" already existed: Edison wrote it in 1878.
Master the first diamond of Code.
Grace Hopper distribuait des fils d'envi: Grace Hopper handed out wires about 30 cm long, the distance light travels in a nanosecond, to explain why a signal cannot go any faster.
Réussir sans faute 3 quiz du Code. Ce qu: Get 3 Code quizzes right without a single mistake. Which, in computing, never happens.
Grace Hopper a terminé sa carrière avec: Grace Hopper ended her career with the rank of rear admiral in the US Navy, and left it in 1986, at 79.
